authority: User explicitly selected these two baselines, then authorized autonomous execution of 5A through 5G with verification before progression.

R32_CUDA.matrix_multiplication: Full FP32 operands and computation on CUDA cores
R32_CUDA.role: High-precision numerical reference and separately reported FP32 performance baseline

F16_TRT.matrix_multiplication: Actual FP16 multiplication, with Tensor Core execution verified for eligible matrix kernels
F16_TRT.nonmatrix_fp32: Permitted for sensitive nonmatrix operations; report precision and conversions explicitly
F16_TRT.fp32_matrix_fallback: Does not meet the selected baseline definition; never silently accept
F16_TRT.role: Optimized floating-point baseline for the primary TensorRT INT8 performance comparison

comparison_interpretation.INT8_TRT_vs_F16_TRT: Primary practical comparison with runtime held constant
comparison_interpretation.INT8_TRT_vs_R32_CUDA: Combined precision/runtime comparison; do not attribute all speedup to quantization

shared_conventions.policy: 1858 logits; mask illegal moves; stable float32 softmax; lexical UCI ties

step5_acceptance.unresolved_numeric_failure: Stop at the failed gate and report the evidence; no automatic tolerance relaxation or replacement with FP32 matrix computation

later_evaluation.move_error: For theoretical W/D roots, count W to D/L or D to L from original mover perspective after selected move
later_evaluation.scope: Syzygy scoring and MCTS studies are later roadmap work, not Step 5 numerical acceptance
